# source: conformance/scenarios/negation.txt

scenario negation/basic-reinclude
kind normative
spec An optional prefix "!" which negates the pattern; any matching file excluded by a previous pattern will become included again.
file .gitignore
| *.log
| !important.log
path debug.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.log
path important.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!important.log
path dir/important.log => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!important.log
path dir/other.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.log
path readme.md => NONE

scenario negation/last-match-wins
kind normative
spec Within one .gitignore file, the last matching pattern decides the outcome.
file .gitignore
| *.txt
| !a.txt
| a.txt
| b.txt
| !b.txt
path a.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:a.txt
path b.txt => INCLUDED # .gitignore:5:!b.txt
path c.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.txt

scenario negation/order-matters
kind normative
spec The order of patterns matters: a negated pattern before the pattern it should override has no effect.
file .gitignore
| !keep.log
| *.log
path keep.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.log
path other.log => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:*.log

scenario negation/negation-without-prior-match
kind normative
spec A negated pattern that matches a path nothing excluded reports an explicit inclusion.
file .gitignore
| !foo
path foo => INCLUDED # .gitignore:1:!foo
path bar => NONE
path dir/foo => INCLUDED # .gitignore:1:!foo

scenario negation/parent-excluded
kind normative
spec It is not possible to re-include a file if a parent directory of that file is excluded.
file .gitignore
| build/
| !build/keep.txt
path build/keep.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/
path build/other.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/
path build/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/
path src/build/keep.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/

scenario negation/parent-excluded-with-wildcard-dir
kind normative
spec It is not possible to re-include a file if a parent directory of that file is excluded.
file .gitignore
| /build
| !/build/keep.txt
path build => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/build
path build/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/build
path build/keep.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/build
path build/sub/keep.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/build

scenario negation/reinclude-by-contents-pattern
kind normative
spec Excluding the contents of a directory with "dir/*" rather than the directory itself makes it possible to re-include entries.
file .gitignore
| build/*
| !build/keep.txt
path build/keep.txt => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!build/keep.txt
path build/other.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/*
path build/sub/file => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:build/*
path build/ => NONE
path build => NONE

scenario negation/reinclude-directory-but-not-its-contents
kind normative
spec A negated directory pattern re-includes the directory only; files inside still match their own rules.
file .gitignore
| /*
| !/src/
| /src/*
| !/src/main/
path README.md => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/*
path src/ => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!/src/
path src/main/ => INCLUDED # .gitignore:4:!/src/main/
path src/main/App.kt => NONE
path src/test/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:/src/*
path src/notes.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:/src/*
path docs/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:/*

scenario negation/escaped-leading-bang
kind normative
spec Put a backslash ("\") in front of the first "!" for patterns that begin with a literal "!", for example, "\!important!.txt".
file .gitignore
| \!important!.txt
path !important!.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:\!important!.txt
path important!.txt => NONE
path dir/!important!.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:\!important!.txt

scenario negation/bang-after-first-character
kind normative
spec An exclamation mark that is not first in the pattern is an ordinary character.
file .gitignore
| a!b
| c!
path a!b => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a!b
path ab => NONE
path c! => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:c!
path dir/c! => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:c!

scenario negation/double-negation
kind normative
spec Only the first exclamation mark is special, so "!!foo" negates the literal pattern "!foo".
file .gitignore
| !!foo
path !foo => INCLUDED # .gitignore:1:!!foo
path foo => NONE
path dir/!foo => INCLUDED # .gitignore:1:!!foo

scenario negation/negated-directory-pattern
kind normative
spec A negated pattern with a trailing slash re-includes only directories.
file .gitignore
| *
| !*/
path a.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*
path dir/ => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!*/
path dir/a.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*
path dir/sub/ => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!*/
path dir => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*

scenario negation/negated-anchored
kind normative
spec A negated anchored pattern only counters matches at the anchored location.
file .gitignore
| *.bin
| !/tool.bin
path tool.bin => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!/tool.bin
path sub/tool.bin => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.bin
path other.bin => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:*.bin

scenario negation/reexclude-after-reinclude
kind normative
spec The last matching pattern wins, so a pattern may exclude again what an earlier negation included.
file .gitignore
| *.tmp
| !*.tmp
| keep/*.tmp
path a.tmp => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!*.tmp
path keep/a.tmp => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:keep/*.tmp
path keep/sub/a.tmp => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!*.tmp
path other/a.tmp => INCLUDED # .gitignore:2:!*.tmp

scenario negation/negated-wildcard-directory
kind normative
spec A file inside an ignored directory stays ignored even when a later negation names it with a wildcard.
file .gitignore
| out/
| !out/**
path out/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:out/
path out/a.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:out/
path out/sub/b.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:out/
